The equation is

\[
|x|+|2y|=10

which simplifies to

\[
|x|+2|y|=10.

This is a diamond-shaped graph. Its vertices occur when one variable is zero:

- If \(x=0\), then \(2|y|=10\), so \(y=\pm5\).
- If \(y=0\), then \(|x|=10\), so \(x=\pm10\).

Thus the vertices are

\[
(10,0),\ (0,5),\ (-10,0),\ (0,-5).
\]

The horizontal diagonal has length \(10-(-10)=20\).  
The vertical diagonal has length \(5-(-5)=10\).

The area of a diamond/rhombus is

\[
\frac{d_1d_2}{2}
\]

so

\[
\text{Area}=\frac{20\cdot 10}{2}=100.
\]

The answer is 100.
